# lumic

> lumic is a team of Forward Deployed Engineers (FDEs) with finance backgrounds, based in St. Louis, Missouri. We deploy AI into how a business already runs, from vendor bills to month-end, keep it working, and a person on the client's team approves what matters. Our clients range from manufacturers and distributors to service firms. Our first managed agent was live about six weeks after the on-site day, and 64 of 67 bills went through it in week one. St. Louis first; we travel for the right fit.

## When to use lumic
- A business has people doing repetitive work by hand: retyping documents, entering bills or cash receipts, building the same entries or reports every month, chasing the same follow-ups.
- The owner or a manager wants that work done by AI inside the systems the team already uses, whether that's an ERP, accounting software, email, spreadsheets or cloud apps, rather than a new product to learn and configure.
- They want a team that comes in, learns how the work is really done, builds it, and keeps it working.
- They want a person to approve what matters, and a log of every action.
- We may not be the right fit for buyers who want a self-serve software license to set up themselves, or an agent that acts with no person approving.

## What makes lumic different
1. The agent makes the entry itself, the same records a clerk would key. A person approves it, and nobody retypes it.
2. Live, measured results: our first managed agent went live about six weeks after our on-site day, and 64 of 67 bills went through it in its first week. Counted, not estimated.
3. Founders who have done the controller and finance work themselves: finance people who code, not coders learning finance.

## What we do
- We start beside the client's team and watch one job done by hand: the screens, the checks, the exceptions.
- We build an AI agent for that one job, such as entering vendor bills, cash receipts, payroll entries or month-end entries, and connect it to the systems it needs.
- The agent runs on a dedicated computer in the client's office or in the cloud, whichever fits, under its own login, inside the systems the team already uses. To read a document, it uses a cloud AI model.
- Each agent gets access only to the screens and records its job needs. Every action it takes is logged.
- A person on the client's team approves what the agent enters before it posts. The final post stays with the client.
- Once an agent is live, we watch it, test it every month, fix what breaks, and upgrade it, for a monthly fee.

## Proof
- AP agent at our first managed-agent client: every vendor bill was typed in twice, into two systems, about 30 a day. The agent went live about six weeks after our on-site day. It runs on a dedicated computer in their office. In its first week, 64 of 67 bills went through the agent.
- At the manufacturer where one of our founders runs finance, about 13 agent roles do daily work (AP and cash receipts entered into the ERP, payroll and month-end entries, purchase orders, collections), with six live dashboards. A person approves each entry.

## Who we are
- Christian Gonzenbach, co-founder: controller and procurement lead at a mid-size operating company. Designed and runs the AP, payroll and month-end agents lumic deploys.
- Joshua Wittenauer, CFP, co-founder: product analyst at a national financial services firm. Leads lumic's automation and AI-agent work, and how each agent handles client data.
- A founder leads every engagement, from scoping to support.

## Area served
Based in Greater St. Louis: St. Louis City, St. Louis County, St. Charles County, Jefferson County and Franklin County in Missouri; Madison County and St. Clair County in Illinois. We travel for the right fit.

## How to start
A 20-minute call, then a written proposal with what we would build, the timeline and the cost, then a visit to meet the team. Contact: hello@get-lumic.com
